name: project-scener
description: Gives each project its own look in the Claude desktop app: a moving backdrop with matching colors, so you can tell at a glance which project a session is in. Pick one with /scene.

defaultLook.title: Default look
defaultLook.description: The look of projects you have not picked one for.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: A look's sound in the desktop app, which plays once you press the speaker in the session's title bar: all of it, its short cues alone, or none.

soundLevel.title: Sound level
soundLevel.description: How loud the looks' sounds are, beside the app's own volume.

messageStyle.title: Message style
messageStyle.description: Draw your messages in the look's own bubbles in the desktop app. Off, they keep the app's own.

ripples.title: Ripples
ripples.description: Play a short ripple where you press the bare backdrop, in the desktop app.
